• Bengaluru FC vs Mumbai City FC || Highlights || Match 30 || 20-Nov-2026 || English ||
The Blues are top of the table! Watch the big moments as Bengaluru FC beat Mumbai City FC 2-0 in Bengaluru to stay unbeaten in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Mumbai City had 16 shots, but Gurpreet Singh Sandhu stood firm. Borja Martínez scored from the spot early in the second half, and Ryan Williams made sure of the points in the 85th minute, finishing off Monirul Molla’s pass.
